description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nugawela, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320335 (23/0661)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, nature of title, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
